notes.title: Our Game Finally Release! Thanks to our supporter and Valve!
notes.notes: Thankfully to all our supporters whom help us along the way! We hope to get some review to help us improve our game for the 2nd Episode! We will strive and listen to your guidance and feedback seriously. I look forward to all who will help us to grow and give us a chance to create the game we love passionately! We as Indie Dev Thank you all!
